## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Added or updated tests (bug fixes: a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] Tried it in a real browser: <!-- Chrome / Edge, learn mode first. Or say "not tried" -->
- [ ] Added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Did **not** bump the version (maintainer does that at release)

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No new permissions, network calls, remote code or `innerHTML`/`eval`
- [ ] Nothing logs or shows cookie values, tokens, passphrases or message contents
- [ ] Auto-approve stays off by default and acts only on an explicit toggle
- [ ] No code or text copied from another project
